purpose: Privacy-safe DOM observation contract for Goofish/Xianyu page familiarization and read-only browser probes.

observationResultSchema.privacyCheckPassed: boolean; must be true before persisting

collectionOrder: Normalize URL to routeShape and classify page id or UNKNOWN_PAGE.
Drop private parameter values before DOM observation.
Wait for page-specific waitForAnchors or known empty/error state.
If stop state is active, record state category and stop.
Read only labels and categories from allowedOutputFields.
Classify visible controls into readable C0-C2 or stopping C3-C4 categories.
If C3/C4 or G3/G4 is visible, record category and stop before action.
Apply textRedactionRules and outputBlacklist before saving.
Save result only if privacyCheckPassed is true.

C0_DISPLAY_NAV.meaning: Navigation, labels, headings, tabs, cards, empty-state containers, close/back/cancel controls.

C1_FILTER_READ.meaning: Search, sort, filters, date ranges, pagination, non-mutating tab changes.

C2_DRAFT_INPUT.meaning: Text, number, template, message, feedback, listing, or appeal draft controls.

C3_FILE_EXTERNAL.meaning: Upload, download, export, QR, app bridge, desktop client, external URL, iframe target.

C4_BUSINESS_COMMIT.meaning: Submit, save, publish, send, pay, refund, ship, delete, permission, identity, promotion, dispute actions.

textRedactionRules.action: drop value; keep field or button label only
keep parameter name and risk category; drop concrete value
keep headers and status category; do not keep row values
keep card slots and button categories; drop identity text and image URLs
keep modal type, cancel control, confirm action category; drop private body values
keep label, input type, validation category; drop entered values

textRedactionRules.matchCategory: QR content, cookie, token, localStorage, sessionStorage

stopTriggerRules.action: ask for explicit user confirmation or stop
record control category only; do not trigger
redact parameter value and require context when private
record route shape and stop reason only
